"Electric 10s" is down to five top prizes after a $30,000 winner was claimed last week. The game started with six top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

If you play "Electric 10s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2772.headline: Top prize count went down

2773.body:
"Sugar Skull Cash" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $100,000 was claimed in this morning's update. Unsold tickets still hold two of the original four. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

Today's free summary of "Sugar Skull Cash" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2773.headline: Top prize count went down

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $10 game with four top prizes of $250,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Every line of The Price is Right™'s prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
